local-llm.quote: works with most cloud LLMs (Claude, GPT/o-series, DeepSeek, Gemini) and local models
local-llm.reason: Terminal coding agent that can drive locally hosted open-weight models for agentic coding.

local-llm.quote: enables running large language models (70B parameters and up) on consumer GPUs with as little as 4GB VRAM
local-llm.reason: Lets you run big models on limited VRAM, and it points to Ollama/llama.cpp as the better-maintained options.

ocr-bench.reason: Hosted OCR/table-extraction API you could add to the PDF-to-markdown benchmark.

hybrid-memory.quote: Decision reference for picking a vector-search index at a given data scale
hybrid-memory.reason: Helps choose a vector index while adding semantic embeddings to the lexical search.

wiki-scale.quote: Best under ~10K-100K vectors, for low query volume, or as the ground truth used to measure recall
wiki-scale.reason: Gives scale thresholds and a recall-measurement method that apply to a wiki growing to about a thousand records.

agent-viz.quote: Built-in liveness checks on dispatched runs, stall triage (diagnose child process tree, kill narrowest thing)
agent-viz.reason: Dispatches background coding agents and has already worked out how to detect and handle hung agents.

ocr-bench.quote: GGUF quantized weights available (Q8_0, Q4_K_M) for deployment without full-precision GPU memory
ocr-bench.reason: Small (8B) vision OCR model that could run on a 16 GB GPU as one of the benchmark candidates.

local-llm.quote: runs 100B models on a single CPU at human reading speed (5-7 tok/s)
local-llm.reason: Local inference framework that uses CPU and RAM, which fits a setup where speed is not the priority.
